name: header-unsupported-format-version
description: A well-formed header declaring format_version 4, header CRC recomputed.
asserts: A newer format than this implementation reads. It must be refused as unsupported, not parsed as v3 on a guess and not reported as corruption: the bytes are intact, so the segment must not be deleted.

header.note: unsupported format version 4 (this implementation reads 3 only)
